ui_bugs.issue: Counter never reaches its target value. Home renders 13/4/7/3 (expected 26/8/28/6) and About renders 1/0/1/0 after 5s wait. Root cause: in /app/frontend/src/components/AnimatedCounter.jsx, `const match = raw.match(...)` produces a NEW array every render and is listed in the useEffect dependency array `[inView, match, duration]`, so every re-render restarts the animation from 0. Fix: memoize match with useMemo or destructure prefix/digits/suffix into strings and depend on those primitives (or raw string). This is a real functional regression — stat values were correct in code but never surface to the user.

rca_of_the_issue: AnimatedCounter useEffect depends on `match` (a fresh regex result object) so every parent re-render (framer-motion FadeUp scroll observers, language context, etc.) cancels the in-flight `animate()` controls and restarts from 0. Because these re-renders continue after the initial view, the displayed value keeps being reset partway through the count-up and never reaches the target. Fix by memoizing `match` on `raw` or by pulling out primitives (prefix, digitsStr, suffix, target) and depending only on those + inView.
